Assassin’s Creed Shadows has grown a lot since its launch, with Ubisoft steadily adding new story content, gameplay improvements, and quality-of-life upgrades. From the major Claws of Awaji expansion and New Game+ mode to improved parkour, photo mode enhancements, and seasonal crossover events, the game now offers more ways to explore, fight, and replay than ever before. Whether you’re revisiting Shadows after a break or diving in for the first time, there’s plenty to see and do across feudal Japan.

In this video, we cover every significant post-launch update for Assassin’s Creed Shadows, including expansions, free quests, difficulty options, endgame systems, and all the new progression features. Learn how Claws of Awaji expands the story and gameplay, discover the latest parkour and movement tweaks, and find out about replayable challenges like Corrupted Castles and Animus Rifts. title: Assassin’s Creed Shadows: Everything Major Added Since Launch

description:
Spoilers follow for 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple!

With the second film in the new 28 Years Later trilogy now in theaters -- which is also the fourth movie in the series overall after 28 Days Later and 28 Weeks Later -- we spoke with The Bone Temple director Nia DaCosta (Candyman, The Marvels) and star Jack O'Connell (Sinners, Back to Black) about the latest foray into the world of Danny Boyle and Alex Garland's infected.

While 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple is actually a fun movie despite being about the end of the world, it's also an intense experience, which should come as no surprise. In particular, the character of Sir Lord Jimmy Crystal is something to behold, with O'Connell really bringing it as this cult leader who grew to adulthood in the age of the Rage virus. The actor and director filled us in on the past, present, and potential (?) future of ol' Jimmy.

BlazBlue Entropy Effect X will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch on February 12, 2026.

author: IGN
description:
Deadpool officially joined the Marvel Rivals roster on January 16 as part of Season 6, and, true to form, he’s doing it his own one-of-a-kind way. In this full Deadpool gameplay breakdown, we dive into everything he brings to the table - whether it’s guns, blades, plushies, or sassy selfies.

Deadpool is the first true multi-role hero in Marvel Rivals, available in Vanguard, Duelist, or Strategist Tactician flavors, each with different ability effects suited to the role. We’ll go over his basic moves and all the variations of his special abilities - like Taunt, Bunny Hop, Hazardous Hijinks, and his pair of Ultimates—quizzing or taunting enemies to devastating effect.

#IGN #Gaming #MarvelRivals
title: Marvel Rivals: Deadpool Gameplay - Full Move Set Breakdown (Season 6)

author: IGN
description:
Check out the Vampires Of The Velvet Lounge trailer for this upcoming film starring Mena Suvari, Dichen Lachman, Stephen Dorff, India Eisley, Tom Berenger, Rosa Salazar, and Tyrese Gibson.

Deep in the American South, a back alley absinthe bar harbors a deadly secret: Countess Elizabeth Báthory and her glamorous coven of vampires keep their killer instincts sharp by preying on lonely singles through dating apps, seducing and slaughtering to preserve their youth. But when Elizabeth swipes right on the wrong profiles—a cunning undercover vampire hunter and a band of emotionally stunted bros—the hunt spirals into hilariously horrifying chaos. Blood flies, fangs pierce flesh, and the bar erupts into a glitter-soaked, green fairy-winged, fang-filled fever dream of grindhouse gore, terrible decisions, and fashionably fatal carnage. 

Vampires Of The Velvet Lounge is produced by Adam Sherman, Marcus Englefield, George Lee; Co-Producer Noémi Santo. Brian O’Shea, Nat McCormick, and Danny Gusma
title: Vampires Of The Velvet Lounge - Official Trailer (2026) Mena Suvari, Dichen Lachman, Rosa Salazar
